messages:
maria_pm: quick sync — customers asking for per-route burst credits + clearer token accounting in pricing docs. want to draft a playbook for prioritization and launch criteria.

sam_engineer: +1. we keep getting asks that embeddings routes should be metered differently from chat (vector dims vs tokens).

alex_research: FYI embeddings cost model is orthogonal: unit = embedding vector, but downstream billing wants equivalent token-based view. we can expose both but need a canonical mapping for invoices.

nina_prodops: constraints: platform needs per-route throttles that can be soft/hard, plus emergency priority lanes for enterprise. implementation timeline depends on ratelimit infra refactor (queued).

jamal_sales: customer example: large retailer wants 3x burst capacity for search embeddings during daily batch windows, but normal chat traffic should not be impacted. wants predictable monthly billing.

maria_pm: proposed scope for MVP: 1) per-route declared quota field (route_quota_units), 2) burst_credit pool per org that can be assigned to routes, 3) explicit pricing doc section mapping "embedding units" -> invoice line items.

sam_engineer: technical notes: route_quota_units should accept "tokens" or "embedding_units". runtime needs to convert and decrement common counter for org. prefer uniform internal accounting unit to keep enforcement simple.

alex_research: conversion: we can translate embeddings to a notional token equivalent (e.g., 1 embedding = X token-units) but call it "billing-equivalent-units" and keep separate metrics for accuracy.

nina_prodops: launch criteria checklist suggestion: docs + SDK support, admin UI for assigning burst credits, telemetry showing per-route enforcement, canary in hosted region, rollback plan.

maria_pm: agree. canary targets: 10 customers incl 2 enterprise, watch latency changes and throttle events. define SLO for <0.5% additional 429s on unaffected routes.

jamal_sales: i'll pull 3 candidate customers for the canary and open NDAs as needed. also ask legal about explicit billing phrasing.

sam_engineer: implementation quick notes: API surface change = add optional fields to route config object: `quota_unit`, `quota_value`, `burst_pool_id`. Add admin endpoints: POST /orgs/:id/burst_pools. enforcement: token-bucket counters at org+route.

ops-bot: deployment note: rate-limiter refactor branch `rl/2026-unify-accounting` pushed to staging at `deploy-1915`.

alex_research: risk: quantization/seq-length changes affect token accounting; need hedges: record raw token counts per request for audits.

maria_pm: action items: sam -> proto + API PR for route fields by EOD Wed; nina -> draft ops runbook + canary plan; jamal -> confirm 3 canary customers and billing language; alex -> conversion doc for embedding->token equivalents. i'll own product spec and launch checklist.

sam_engineer: noted. I'll include tests for cross-route fallback (priority lane should not starve normal routes).

nina_prodops: add monitoring alerts: elevated 429 rate, sudden cost delta >20% in 24h, backlog queue growth.

maria_pm: TL;DR: MVP = per-route quota fields + burst pools + billing mapping for embeddings. launch only after docs, SDK + UI admin, canary with customers, and telemetry in place. objections?

jamal_sales: none, sounds good. timeline?

maria_pm: aiming for alpha canary in 6 weeks, GA in ~12 weeks if no major blockers.

alex_research: make sure we version the billing schema so we can roll back pricing mappings without breaking invoices.

sam_engineer: will add `billing_schema_version` to route configs.

maria_pm: perfect — thanks team. I'll put this thread into the roadmap doc and open the PR templates. :rocket:

ops-bot: reminder: weekly infra sync Thursday 09:30 to review `rl/2026-unify-accounting` progress.
